title: Basic Syntax

story.introduction:
You wake up in darkness. Systems rebooting...

MENTOR-9's voice crackles: "PROTO-7, can you hear me? Our ship crashed. We're on planet Syntax-IV. First things first - can you communicate?"

"Try the Log protocol. It's how we robots talk to the diagnostic system."
story.context: The Log keyword is the most basic form of robot communication. It outputs messages to the diagnostic log, allowing you to see what's happening during test execution.

learningObjectives: Understand test case structure (*** Test Cases *** section)
Use the Log keyword to output messages
Apply proper indentation (4 spaces for test content)
Use different log levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR)
Distinguish between Log and Log To Console
